domain_isolation.description: All core domains (Identity, Publication, Certification, Reputation, AI, Federation) are strictly isolated and do not share persistence layers directly.

dependency_direction.description: Dependencies flow inward from Presentation Layer -> Application Layer -> Domain Context -> Infrastructure. No inward dependencies from Infrastructure observed.

domain_leakage.description: No domain logic leaked into the Presentation or Infrastructure layers. Multi-tenancy logic is properly encapsulated in the Infrastructure layer via TenantContext.

provider_runtime_boundary.description: Database (Supabase) and Cache (Redis) providers are abstracted via interfaces. No direct vendor SDK usage inside core domains.

ai_governance_boundary.description: AI Intelligence layer respects the privacy constraints of the Identity Core. Embeddings generation and Vector Search (HNSW) execute securely within the AI boundary.

presentation_separation.description: React Server Components and Client Components interact with Domain Services strictly via defined Actions and APIs. No direct SQL queries from UI components.

conclusion: The APASIFIC IAEEA architecture is completely aligned with the Golden Rules. The Bounded Contexts are Frozen and structurally sound for global enterprise deployment.
